source: make a 3d deltarune inspired game with all the features deltarune has and in the overworld, make 2 people follow you (susie, and ralsei) add anything else thsts needed

image_prompt.text: A settlement on the overworld, free of hostile AI, where the party restocks and talks to townsfolk
Visible blockades - guarded bridges, locked gates - stopping the party from entering later areas early
two companion characters walking behind the player through the overworld

layout_placement.text: Points on the overworld where encounters come from

notes: Shape, town, mob emitters and level gates all come from the preset; the prompt named only an overworld and two followers.
All the features the referenced game has is unbounded and cannot be turned into layout picks. A real build would have to ask what subset is wanted.
The party-follow behaviour for the two companions is a mechanic with no spatial footprint.

open_questions.ask: The only style cue is the name of another game - should this read as bright and cartoony, or dark and storybook?
What is in the overworld besides the path - a town, dungeons, separate areas?
Which features matter most: the walking overworld, the turn-based fights, or the story scenes?

coverage_missing.ask: What visual style should the world have?
Does the overworld feed separate instanced areas, or is everything on one surface?
Which features specifically - battles, shops, party swapping, cutscenes? The list is unbounded as written.
How large should the overworld be?

answers.ask: The only style cue is the name of another game - should this read as bright and cartoony, or dark and storybook?
answers.answer: Use a dark storybook fantasy look with colorful cartoon characters and readable, playful environments, matching the Deltarune-inspired tone.

answers.ask: What is in the overworld besides the path - a town, dungeons, separate areas?
answers.answer: Build a small overworld with separate connected areas: a simple town hub, paths, and one dungeon area for the first playable slice.

answers.ask: Which features matter most: the walking overworld, the turn-based fights, or the story scenes?
answers.answer: Prioritize the walking overworld with Susie and Ralsei following the player, then simple turn-based fights; keep story scenes minimal.
